title: DevOps Engineer
description: Learn configuration automation, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, cloud computing administration, container architecture, and system observability.

nodes.title: Linux & Shell Scripting
nodes.description: Understand Linux OS structure, process management, file permissions, shell variables, and scripting automations.
projectIdeas: Write a bash script that periodically zips local server log files and moves them to a backup folder.
interviewQuestions: How do you check current memory usage and disk space in Linux?
What is a soft link vs hard link?

nodes.title: CI/CD & GitHub Actions
nodes.description: Set up continuous build, lint test automation, and code deployments upon git push hooks.
projectIdeas: Configure a GitHub action pipeline that runs ESLint and jest test assertions on every pull request.
interviewQuestions: What is the difference between Continuous Integration, Delivery, and Deployment?
What are runner agents in CI/CD?

nodes.title: Kubernetes Orchestration
nodes.description: Deploy and manage large-scale container clusters. Learn pods, services, deployments, ingress, configmaps, and secrets.
projectIdeas: Deploy a multi-container web app setup (frontend, backend, database) inside a local minikube cluster.
interviewQuestions: What is a Pod in Kubernetes?
Explain the role of Kubelet and API server in Kubernetes master control.
